title: Create Alembic baseline for catalog and write guard
requirements: Set up Alembic with explicit DATABASE_URL input and a migration-only path; runtime schema ownership remains separate from the application database role.

Create the baseline migration only for business_write_guard, club_settings, services and service_options, including normative UUID, version, enum/check, foreign-key and index constraints from ARCH-006.
Do not seed commercial catalog data, create inquiries, contacts, visits, money records, authentication, bots, public endpoints or business commands.
Add a PostgreSQL integration test that upgrades an empty disposable schema/database and proves the guard singleton and catalog constraints; document the local command and cleanup boundary.
acceptance: An empty PostgreSQL target upgrades to the DB-001 Alembic head and contains the required four tables and guard row.
The integration test rejects duplicate guard identity and invalid catalog pricing-mode combinations.
No client, booking, payment or channel behavior is introduced.

shared_paths_approval.reason: The user authorized implementation and Docker PostgreSQL is now verified locally; the accepted schema calls for a migration-only baseline before vertical business behavior.
